/* A browser minimum font size (an accessibility setting, common on phones)
   overrides any font-size below it. The hero's labels are 10-13px and sit
   inside boxes painted on the artwork, so they were being forced up and
   spilling over each other. The layer is now built four times actual size,
   where every label is comfortably above any such floor, then scaled back
   down -- a transform is geometry, not type, so nothing can override it.
   The cqw units do the arithmetic themselves: the container is 4x wider,
   so the computed pixel sizes are 4x larger and land identically. */

   Gold on black goes flat without a little light behind it. This adds
   depth without brightening the palette: nothing changes colour, the
   type just stops sitting dead on the background. Light mode gets none
   of it, where glow would only look like a printing fault. */

  /* ── RENDER: regions (spotlight ribbon, finished behaviour) ── */
  var regionsSec=$('regions'), regionsTrack=$('regionsTrack'), regionPanel=$('regionPanel');
  function buildRegions(){
    if(!regionsTrack) return;
    var html='';
    for(var d=0; d<2; d++){
      REGIONS.forEach(function(r,i){ html+='<button class="region" data-i="'+i+'">'+esc(r[0])+'</button>'; });
    }
    regionsTrack.innerHTML=html;
    var nodes=Array.prototype.slice.call(regionsTrack.querySelectorAll('.region'));
    var half=regionsTrack.scrollWidth/2 || 1;
    var x=0, speed=46/1000, last=null, paused=false;
    var demoDone=false, userTapped=false, demoTimer=null;
    var SPOT=0.5, RANGE=0.16;
    function frame(ts){
      if(last==null)last=ts; var dt=ts-last; last=ts;
      if(!paused && !RM){ x-=speed*dt; if(-x>=half)x+=half; }
      regionsTrack.style.transform='translateX('+x+'px)';
      var vw=regionsSec.clientWidth, centre=vw*SPOT, best=-1, bestD=1e9;
      nodes.forEach(function(nd){
        var r=nd.getBoundingClientRect(), pr=regionsSec.getBoundingClientRect();
        var cxp=(r.left+r.width/2)-pr.left, d=Math.abs(cxp-centre)/vw;
        var t=Math.max(0,1-d/RANGE), scale=0.82+t*0.85;
        nd.style.transform='translateY(-50%) scale('+scale+')';
        nd.style.color = t>0.55?'var(--gold-light)':(t>0.15?'var(--gold)':'var(--dim)');
        nd.style.setProperty('--glow', t.toFixed(3));
        var i=+nd.getAttribute('data-i');
        if(d<bestD){bestD=d;best=i;}
      });
      if(!demoDone && !userTapped && bestD<0.012){
        demoDone=true; openDemo(best);
        demoTimer=setTimeout(function(){ closeDemo(); }, 2600);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    function render(i){
      var r=REGIONS[i];
      regionPanel.innerHTML='<h3>'+esc(r[0])+'</h3><div class="rrule"></div><p class="muted">'+esc(r[1])+'</p><p>'+esc(r[2])+'</p><p class="opp">'+esc(r[3])+'</p>'
        +'<div class="cta-wrap"><a class="cta" href="#access"><span class="cta__text">CONNECT YOUR BUSINESS</span><span class="cta__conduit"><span class="cta__dot"></span></span></a></div>';
      /* the travelling light-point is measured from the rendered text, so a
         CTA built after page load has to be measured when it is built */
      if(typeof measureCTAs==='function') measureCTAs();
      regionPanel.classList.add('is-shown');
    }
    function openDemo(i){ paused=true; render(i); }
    function closeDemo(){ if(userTapped)return; paused=false; regionPanel.classList.remove('is-shown'); last=null; }
    function open(i){ userTapped=true; if(demoTimer)clearTimeout(demoTimer); paused=true; render(i); }
    function close(){ userTapped=true; paused=false; regionPanel.classList.remove('is-shown'); last=null; }
    /* TAPPING AGAIN LETS IT GO.
       The ribbon paused on a tap and only resumed when the reader
       happened to tap outside the whole section — so tapping the same
       region again, or the panel, or anywhere within the band, left it
       frozen. Now the open region closes on a second tap, another
       region swaps to it, and a tap anywhere else releases it. */
    var openIdx = -1;
    nodes.forEach(function(nd){
      var i=+nd.getAttribute('data-i');
      nd.addEventListener('click',function(e){
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        if(openIdx === i){ openIdx = -1; close(); }
        else { openIdx = i; open(i); }
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      /* any tap that is not a region button releases the ribbon,
         including one inside the section or on the panel itself */
      if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.region')) return;
      if(openIdx !== -1){ openIdx = -1; close(); }
    });
    if(!RM) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    else { nodes[0].style.transform='translateY(-50%) scale(1.5)'; nodes[0].style.setProperty('--glow','1'); }
  }

  /* ── RENDER: credits ── */
  function buildLangs(){
    var el=$('langList'); if(!el) return;
    var perCol=Math.ceil(LANGS.length/3);
    var cols=[LANGS.slice(0,perCol),LANGS.slice(perCol,perCol*2),LANGS.slice(perCol*2)];
    el.innerHTML=cols.map(function(col){
      return '<div class="credits__region">'+col.map(esc).join('<br>')+'</div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function buildCountries(){
    var el=$('countryList'); if(!el) return;
    /* explicit columns, not grid auto-flow: the regions differ hugely in length,
       so row-based flow leaves ragged gaps. Caribbean and Oceania sit in the left
       column to balance it against Africa and Asia. */
    var by={}; COUNTRIES.forEach(function(c){ by[c[0]]=c[1]; });
    var COLS=[
      ["Africa","Caribbean","Oceania"],
      ["Asia","MENA","North America"],
      ["Europe","Europe / MENA","Latin America"]
    ];
    var used={};
    COLS.forEach(function(col){ col.forEach(function(n){ used[n]=1; }); });
    COUNTRIES.forEach(function(c){ if(!used[c[0]]) COLS[2].push(c[0]); });
    el.innerHTML=COLS.map(function(col){
      return '<div class="credits__col">'+col.filter(function(n){return by[n];}).map(function(n){
        return '<div class="credits__region"><b>'+esc(n)+'</b>'+esc(by[n])+'</div>';
      }).join('')+'</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

    ],
    [

  /* The per-industry figures were invented and then multiplied by
     invented factors for scope and intent. They now come from what BACI
     has actually collected, and where that is not yet meaningful the
     statement stands on its own without a number. */
  var SIGNAL_API='https://api.bacihq.com/api/signals', indSignalCache={};
  function indFetchSignals(ind, scope, place, done){
    var key=(ind||'')+'|'+(scope||'worldwide')+'|'+(place||'');
    if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(indSignalCache,key)){ done(indSignalCache[key]); return; }
    var qs='industry='+encodeURIComponent(String(ind||'').toLowerCase());
    if(scope==='country'&&place) qs+='&scope=country&code='+encodeURIComponent(place);
    else if(scope==='region'&&place) qs+='&scope=region&code='+encodeURIComponent(place);
    fetch(SIGNAL_API+'?'+qs,{credentials:'omit'})
      .then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; })
      .then(function(j){
        var v=(j&&j.sufficient&&typeof j.signals==='number')?j.signals:null;
        indSignalCache[key]=v; done(v);
      })
      .catch(function(){ indSignalCache[key]=null; done(null); });
  }

  function buildIndustryEngine(){
    var indState={industry:"Social Media",intent:null,scope:null,place:null,sub:null};
    var indHasNumber=false, indTargetVal=0, indShownVal=0;
    function indFmt(n){ return Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-GB'); }
    function indBuildStatement(){
      var ind=indState.industry.toUpperCase();
      var hasGeo = indState.scope && (indState.scope==='global' || indState.place);
      var scopeTok = !hasGeo ? null : (indState.scope==='global' ? 'GLOBAL' : indState.place.toUpperCase());
      if(!hasGeo && !indState.intent){ return 'ANALYSING '+ind+' SIGNALS IN REAL TIME'; }
      if(hasGeo && !indState.intent){
        if(indState.scope==='global') return 'ANALYSING '+ind+' INTELLIGENCE ACROSS <span class="lit">'+IND_GLOBAL_MARKETS+'</span> MARKETS';
        return 'ANALYSING '+ind+' INTELLIGENCE · <span class="lit">'+scopeTok+'</span>';
      }
      var iw=INTENT_WORD[indState.intent.k]||'', sc=scopeTok||'GLOBAL';
      return 'ANALYSING '+ind+' '+iw+' SIGNALS · <span class="lit">'+sc+'</span>';
    }
    function indRefreshCounter(){
      var stmt=$('indCounterStmt'); if(stmt) stmt.innerHTML=indBuildStatement();
      var indDetail=$('indCounterDetail');
      if(indDetail){ indDetail.style.animation='none'; indDetail.textContent=INDUSTRY_COPY[indState.industry]||''; void indDetail.offsetWidth; indDetail.style.animation=''; }
      var scope = indState.scope==='global' ? 'worldwide' : indState.scope;
      indFetchSignals(indState.industry, scope, indState.place||null, function(v){
        /* Intent no longer scales the number: multiplying a real count
           by an invented factor would make it invented again. The
           statement already carries the intent in words. */
        var num=$('indCounterNum');
        if(typeof v==='number'){
          indHasNumber=true; indTargetVal=v;
          if(num) num.style.display='';
        } else {
          indHasNumber=false; indTargetVal=0; indShownVal=0;
          if(num){ num.textContent=''; num.style.display='none'; }
        }
      });
    }
    function indTick(){
      var num=$('indCounterNum');
      if(indHasNumber && num){
        indShownVal += (indTargetVal-indShownVal)*0.08;
        var drift = indTargetVal*0.0003*Math.sin(Date.now()/900);
        num.textContent=indFmt(indShownVal+drift);
      }
      if(num) requestAnimationFrame(indTick);
    }
    /* Each pair is the painted label's left and right edge in the 1536-wide
       artwork, in tile order. The boxes were measured off the file, so the
       invisible tab and the rule it draws land on the name itself. */
    var TAB_X=[[31,123],[154,228],[256,328],[360,433],[460,500],[537,618],[650,723],[753,790],
               [819,887],[917,995],[1030,1114],[1139,1185],[1210,1283],[1305,1364],[1387,1509]];
    var TILE_W=1536, TILE_H=1024, TAB_TOP=460, TAB_BOT=496;
    function indRenderTabs(){
      var t=$('indTabs'); if(!t) return;
      t.innerHTML=INDUSTRY_LIST.map(function(n,i){
        var b=TAB_X[i]; if(!b) return '';
        /* the hit box runs to the midpoint between neighbouring names; the rule
           is a child placed back over the word itself */
        var prev=TAB_X[i-1], next=TAB_X[i+1];
        var hL = prev ? (prev[1]+b[0])/2 : 20;
        var hR = next ? (b[1]+next[0])/2 : TILE_W-20;
        var st='left:'+(hL/TILE_W*100).toFixed(3)+'%;width:'+((hR-hL)/TILE_W*100).toFixed(3)+'%;'+
               'top:'+(TAB_TOP/TILE_H*100).toFixed(3)+'%;height:'+((TAB_BOT-TAB_TOP)/TILE_H*100).toFixed(3)+'%';
        var rs='left:'+((b[0]-hL)/(hR-hL)*100).toFixed(3)+'%;width:'+((b[1]-b[0])/(hR-hL)*100).toFixed(3)+'%';
        var on=n===indState.industry;
        return '<button type="button" role="tab" class="ind-tab'+(on?' is-active':'')+'" style="'+st+'"'+
               ' aria-selected="'+on+'" data-ind="'+esc(n)+'"><span class="ind-tab__rule" style="'+rs+'"></span>'+
               '<span class="visually-hidden">'+esc(n)+'</span></button>';
      }).join('');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(t.querySelectorAll('.ind-tab'),function(b){
        b.addEventListener('click',function(){ indSwitchIndustry(b.getAttribute('data-ind')); });
      });
    }
    function indRenderIntents(){
      $('indIntentChips').innerHTML=INTENTS.map(function(i){return '<button class="ind-chip'+(indState.intent&&indState.intent.k===i.k?' ind-sel':'')+'" data-k="'+i.k+'">'+esc(i.label)+'</button>';}).join('');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call($('indIntentChips').querySelectorAll('.ind-chip'),function(b){

    function indRenderWhere(){

      Array.prototype.forEach.call($('indWhereChips').querySelectorAll('.ind-chip'),function(b){
        b.addEventListener('click',function(){

    function indRenderPlace(){

      $('indPlaceLabel').textContent = indState.scope==='region' ? 'Select region' : 'Select country';
      $('indPlaceChips').innerHTML=list.map(function(c){return '<button class="ind-chip'+(indState.place===c?' ind-sel':'')+'" data-p="'+esc(c)+'">'+esc(c)+'</button>';}).join('');

    function indRenderSub(){

      $('indSubChips').innerHTML=subs.map(function(s){return '<button class="ind-chip'+(indState.sub===s?' ind-sel':'')+'" data-s="'+esc(s)+'">'+esc(s)+'</button>';}).join('');
      Array.prototype.forEach.call($('indSubChips').querySelectorAll('.ind-chip'),function(b){

    function indResultCards(){
      var ind=indState.industry, intent=indState.intent?indState.intent.label:'Opportunities';
      var where=(indState.scope==='global'?'Global':(indState.place||'Global')), sub=indState.sub||'';
      return [
        {tag:intent+" · "+where, headline:"Live opportunities detected", body:"BACI is currently tracking multiple active "+ind.toLowerCase()+" "+(indState.intent?indState.intent.label.toLowerCase():"opportunities")+" in "+where+" within "+(sub||"this sector")+".", band:"Signal strength · Strong"},
        {tag:"Market movement", headline:"Conditions shifting now", body:"Demand and regulatory signals in "+where+" are moving in ways that change what is worth pursuing this quarter.", band:"Confidence · High"},
        {tag:"Capital & partners", headline:"The missing piece", body:"Where an opportunity requires capability, capital or a partner you don't yet have, BACI identifies what is missing and who could supply it.", band:"Matches · Available"},
        {tag:"Timing", headline:"Act before the window closes", body:"Some of these "+ind.toLowerCase()+" opportunities in "+where+" are time-bound. BACI surfaces them before your competitors evaluate them.", band:"Urgency · Elevated"}
      ];
    }
    function indShowResults(){
      var ind=indState.industry.toUpperCase(), iw=indState.intent?(INTENT_WORD[indState.intent.k]||''):'';
      var scope = indState.scope==='global' ? 'GLOBAL' : (indState.place? indState.place.toUpperCase() : 'GLOBAL');
      $('indResultsHead').innerHTML=ind+' '+iw+' · '+scope+(indState.sub?' · '+indState.sub.toUpperCase():'');
      $('indRGrid').innerHTML=indResultCards().map(function(c){
        return '<div class="ind-rcard"><p class="ind-rcard__tag">'+esc(c.tag)+'</p><p class="ind-rcard__headline">'+esc(c.headline)+'</p><p class="ind-rcard__body">'+esc(c.body)+'</p><p class="ind-rcard__band">'+esc(c.band)+'</p></div>';

      $('indResults').classList.add('ind-show');
    }
    function indSwitchIndustry(ind){
      if(ind===indState.industry)return;
      indState.industry=ind; indState.intent=null; indState.scope=null; indState.place=null; indState.sub=null;
      indRenderTabs(); indRenderIntents(); indRenderWhere(); indRenderPlace(); indRenderSub();
      $('indQWhere').classList.remove('ind-q--show'); $('indPlaceWrap').classList.remove('ind-q--show'); $('indQSub').classList.remove('ind-q--show');
      $('indResults').classList.remove('ind-show');
      indRefreshCounter();
    }
    /* the search panel lives outside this closure, so it asks by event */
    document.addEventListener('baci:industry', function(e){
      var d = e.detail || {};
      if(!d.industry) return;
      if(d.industry !== indState.industry) indSwitchIndustry(d.industry);
      if(d.sub){
        indState.sub = d.sub;
        $('indQWhere').classList.add('ind-q--show');
        $('indQSub').classList.add('ind-q--show');
        indRenderSub();
      }
      indRefreshCounter();
      $('indQIntent').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
    });
    $('indRefineBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
      $('indResults').classList.remove('ind-show');
      $('indQIntent').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
    });
    indRenderTabs(); indRenderIntents(); indRenderWhere(); indRenderPlace(); indRenderSub();
    indRefreshCounter();
    if(!RM) requestAnimationFrame(indTick);
    else if(indHasNumber){ var n0=$('indCounterNum'); if(n0) n0.textContent=indFmt(indTargetVal); }
  }

  /* ── conversion intelligence: revolving ring, top-pop, finished ── */
  function buildWheel(){
    var ring=$('cring'), panel=$('wheelPanel'); if(!ring) return;
    var n=WHEEL.length, nodes=[];
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var b=document.createElement('button');
      b.className='cnode'; b.setAttribute('data-i',i);
      b.setAttribute('aria-label',WHEEL[i]);
      var short=WHEEL[i].replace(' Intelligence','');
      b.innerHTML='<span class="cnode__circle"><span class="cnode__label">'+esc(short)+'</span></span>';
      ring.appendChild(b); nodes.push(b);
    }
    var base=-Math.PI/2, ang=0, speed=0.00010, last=null, paused=false, active=-1, focusIdx=-1;
    var NODE_PCT=0.155;
    function place(){
      /* THE RING MUST BE SQUARE AND MUST AGREE WITH ITSELF.
         This measured width only and centred the nodes on (W/2, W/2),
         while the centre circle is placed by CSS at top:50% of the
         element's HEIGHT. Wherever aspect-ratio:1 did not hold — an
         older Safari, a flex parent, a text-size change — the two
         disagreed: the nodes orbited one point and the BACI circle sat
         at another, and the whole arrangement drifted off its margin.
         Squaring the element here makes the two definitions the same
         one. */
      var W=ring.clientWidth||1;
      if(Math.abs(ring.clientHeight - W) > 1) ring.style.height = W + 'px';
      var H=ring.clientHeight||W;
      var S=Math.min(W,H);
      var px=S*NODE_PCT, R=(S*0.5)-(px*0.5)-2, cx=W*0.5, cy=H*0.5;
      var topI=-1, topDist=1e9;
      for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
        var a=base+ang+(i/n)*Math.PI*2;
        /* Node coordinates are their CENTRES; CSS translate(-50%,-50%) centres each circle. */
        var x=cx+R*Math.cos(a), y=cy+R*Math.sin(a);
        nodes[i].style.left=x+'px'; nodes[i].style.top=y+'px';
        nodes[i].style.width=px+'px'; nodes[i].style.height=px+'px';
        var na=Math.atan2(Math.sin(a),Math.cos(a)), d=Math.abs(na-(-Math.PI/2));
        if(d>Math.PI)d=2*Math.PI-d;
        if(d<topDist){topDist=d;topI=i;}
      }
      if(active<0 && topI!==focusIdx){
        if(focusIdx>=0)nodes[focusIdx].classList.remove('is-focus');
        nodes[topI].classList.add('is-focus'); focusIdx=topI;
      }
    }
    function frame(ts){
      if(last==null)last=ts; var dt=ts-last; last=ts;
      if(!paused && !RM){ ang+=speed*dt; }
      place(); requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    place();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    if(window.ResizeObserver){ new ResizeObserver(place).observe(ring); }
    else { window.addEventListener('resize', place); }
    if(document.fonts && document.fonts.ready){ document.fonts.ready.then(place); }
    function open(i){
      active=i; paused=true; ring.classList.add('has-active');
      nodes.forEach(function(nd){nd.classList.remove('is-active','is-focus');}); focusIdx=-1;
      nodes[i].classList.add('is-active');
      clearTimeout(panelClear);
      panel.innerHTML='<h3>'+esc(WHEEL[i])+'</h3><p>'+esc(WHEEL_INFO[WHEEL[i]]||'')+'</p>';
      panel.classList.add('is-shown');
    }
    var panelClear=null;
    function close(){
      active=-1; paused=false; ring.classList.remove('has-active');
      nodes.forEach(function(nd){nd.classList.remove('is-active');});
      panel.classList.remove('is-shown');
      /* empty it once it has faded, so a closed panel holds no height */
      clearTimeout(panelClear);
      panelClear=setTimeout(function(){ if(active<0) panel.innerHTML=''; },560);
    }
    nodes.forEach(function(nd,i){
      nd.addEventListener('click',function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); (active===i)?close():open(i); });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(!ring.contains(e.target) && !panel.contains(e.target)) close();
    });
  }

  /* ── RENDER: access grid ── */
  function buildAccess(){
    var el=$('accessGrid'); if(!el) return;
    el.innerHTML=ACCESS.map(function(a){
      return '<a class="acard" href="'+a[2]+'"><h3>'+esc(a[0])+'</h3><div class="acard__rule"></div><p>'+esc(a[1])+'</p></a>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* ── SPLASH sequence ── */
  function runSplash(){
    var splash=$('splash'); if(!splash) return;
    var seen=false; try{seen=sessionStorage.getItem('baci_splash')==='1';}catch(e){}
    if(seen){ splash.parentNode.removeChild(splash); return; }
    try{sessionStorage.setItem('baci_splash','1');}catch(e){}
    if(RM){
      setTimeout(dismiss,1200);
    }else{
      var mark=$('splashMark'), start=null, dur=1800;
      function draw(ts){
        if(!start)start=ts;
        var p=Math.min((ts-start)/dur,1);
        mark.style.setProperty('--wipe',(p*100)+'%');
        if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        else{ splash.classList.add('spark-on'); setTimeout(dismiss,1000); }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    function dismiss(){ splash.classList.add('is-gone'); setTimeout(function(){ if(splash.parentNode)splash.parentNode.removeChild(splash); },1300); }
    ['wheel','touchstart','keydown','click'].forEach(function(ev){
      window.addEventListener(ev,function once(){ dismiss(); window.removeEventListener(ev,once); },{passive:true});
    });
  }

  /* ── count-up stats ── */
  function countUp(el){
    var target=+el.getAttribute('data-count'), suf=el.getAttribute('data-suffix')||'';
    if(RM){ el.textContent=target+suf; return; }
    var t0=null, d=1400;
    function step(ts){ if(!t0)t0=ts; var p=Math.min((ts-t0)/d,1); var e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
      el.textContent=Math.round(target*e)+suf; if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step); }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  /* ── CTA measure (all CTAs) ── */
  function measureCTAs(){
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.cta'),function(cta){
      var text=cta.querySelector('.cta__text'), conduit=cta.querySelector('.cta__conduit');
      if(!text||!conduit)return;
      var w=text.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      var size=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(text).fontSize)||16;
      var span=w-(size*0.30);
      conduit.style.width=span+'px';
      conduit.style.setProperty('--travel',span+'px');
    });
  }

  /* ── reveal + count observers ── */
  function observe(){
    if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'),function(r){r.classList.add('is-in');});
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.stat__num[data-count]'),countUp);
      return;
    }
    var ro=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(en){if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('is-in');ro.unobserve(en.target);}});},{threshold:.12});
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'),function(r){ro.observe(r);});
    var co=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(en){if(en.isIntersecting){countUp(en.target);co.unobserve(en.target);}});},{threshold:.5});
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.stat__num[data-count]'),function(s){co.observe(s);});
  }

  /* ── film modal ── */
  function film(){
    var modal=$('filmModal'), open=[$('filmPlay'),$('heroFilm')], close=$('filmClose');
    function show(){modal.classList.add('is-open');}
    function hide(){modal.classList.remove('is-open');}
    open.forEach(function(b){if(b)b.addEventListener('click',show);});
    if(close)close.addEventListener('click',hide);
    if(modal)modal.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===modal)hide();});
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')hide();});
  }


  /* HERO SIGNAL COUNTER — REAL, OR ABSENT.
     This began at a made-up 37,942,118 and climbed a few hundred every
     frame for as long as the page stayed open, so the figure a visitor
     read depended on how long they had been looking at it. It now shows
     what BACI is actually watching, and where that is not yet a
     meaningful number the line reads "Analysing signals in real time"
     without one. */
  (function(){
    var el = $('heroCount'); if(!el) return;
    el.textContent = '';

    fetch('https://api.bacihq.com/api/signals/total', { credentials:'omit' })
      .then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function(j){
        if(!j || !j.sufficient || typeof j.signals !== 'number'){
          var gap = el.previousSibling;
          if(gap && gap.nodeType === 3) gap.textContent = gap.textContent.replace(/\s+$/,' ');
          if(el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
          return;
        }
        var target = j.signals;
        el.textContent = target.toLocaleString('en-GB');
        if(RM) return;
        var t0 = null;
        requestAnimationFrame(function tick(ts){
          if(!t0) t0 = ts;
          /* a small drift so it reads as live; it never departs from the
             real figure by more than a rounding error, and never climbs */
          var drift = Math.sin((ts-t0)/1400) * Math.max(1, target*0.00002);
          el.textContent = Math.round(target + drift).toLocaleString('en-GB');
          requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        });
      })
      .catch(function(){ if(el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el); });
  })();


  /* SMOOTH IN-PAGE MOVEMENT, EVERYWHERE.
     scroll-behavior:smooth is CSS-only and Safari ignored it until
     15.4, so on an iPhone the page jumped instantly from the hero to
     the section — the "boom" rather than the glide. This animates the
     scroll itself, which every browser honours.

     The easing is deliberately long and soft at both ends: the point is
     that a section appears to open rather than that the page travels to
     it. Reduced-motion users still get the instant move they asked for. */
  function glide(){
    if(RM) return;
    var DURATION = 1150;

    function ease(t){
      /* slow to leave, slow to arrive, quick in the middle — the shape
         that reads as a reveal rather than a scroll */
      return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;
    }

    function scrollTo(target){
      var start = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      var rect  = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      var end   = start + rect.top;
      var max   = Math.max(0, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
      if(end > max) end = max;
      var dist = end - start;
      if(Math.abs(dist) < 2) return;


      var t0 = null;
      function step(ts){
        if(t0 === null) t0 = ts;
        var p = Math.min((ts - t0) / DURATION, 1);

        /* Re-read the target each frame. If an image finishes loading
           mid-glide and moves the section, the glide follows it instead
           of arriving where it used to be — which is what made one tap
           feel like two or three. */
        var now = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        var live = now + target.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        var cap  = Math.max(0, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
        if(live > cap) live = cap;
        if(Math.abs(live - end) > 4){ end = live; dist = end - start; }

        window.scrollTo(0, start + dist * ease(p));
        if(p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var a = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]') : null;
      if(!a) return;
      var id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if(!id || id === '#') return;
      var target = document.querySelector(id);
      if(!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      scrollTo(target);
      /* the address bar still reflects where the reader is, without the
         browser performing a second jump of its own */
      /* a convenience, never allowed to interrupt the scroll */
      try{
        if(window.history && window.history.replaceState){
          window.history.replaceState(null, '', id);
        }
      }catch(err){}
    }, false);
  }

  /* ── init ── */
  /* INTRODUCING spells itself out on a loop, each letter flaring to champagne,
     settling, then dissolving in the same order before it writes itself again */
  (function(){
    var w=document.getElementById('introWord'); if(!w) return;
    var txt=w.textContent, frag='';
    for(var i=0;i<txt.length;i++){
      frag+='<span style="animation-delay:'+(i*0.085).toFixed(3)+'s">'+
            (txt[i]===' '?'&nbsp;':txt[i])+'</span>';
    }
    w.innerHTML=frag;
    if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){ w.classList.add('is-spelling'); return; }
    /* it keeps cycling, but only while it is on screen, so it is not
       spending battery animating somewhere nobody is looking */
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
      w.classList.toggle('is-spelling', es[0].isIntersecting);
    },{threshold:.35});
    io.observe(w);
  })();

  /* the roll carries two copies of itself and travels exactly one copy's
     worth, so the window is full at every point of the cycle instead of
     starting empty and filling up */
  function loopCredits(){
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.credits__inner'),function(inner){
      if(inner.getAttribute('data-looped')) return;
      inner.setAttribute('data-looped','1');
      var copy=document.createDocumentFragment();
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(inner.children,function(node){
        var c=node.cloneNode(true);
        c.removeAttribute('id');
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(c.querySelectorAll('[id]'),function(x){x.removeAttribute('id');});
        c.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
        copy.appendChild(c);
      });
      inner.appendChild(copy);
    });
  }

  buildRegions(); buildLangs(); buildCountries(); buildSignals(); loopCredits();
  buildIndustryEngine(); buildWheel(); buildAccess();
  observe(); film(); runSplash(); glide();
  /* thoughts box collapses until asked for */
  var tOpen  = document.getElementById('thoughts-open');
  var tPanel = document.getElementById('thoughts-panel');
  if(tOpen && tPanel){
    tOpen.addEventListener('click', function(){
      tOpen.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      tOpen.classList.add('hidden');
      tPanel.classList.add('open');
      document.getElementById('thoughts-text').focus();
    });
  }
  measureCTAs();
  window.addEventListener('resize',measureCTAs);
  window.addEventListener('load',measureCTAs);
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(measureCTAs);
})();
</script>

<div class="a11y-panel" id="a11yPanel" role="dialog" aria-label="Display settings" aria-modal="false">
  <h4>Display</h4>

      <button type="button" class="a11y-step" id="a11ySmaller" aria-label="Smaller text">&minus;</button>
      <button type="button" class="a11y-step" id="a11yLarger" aria-label="Larger text">+</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="a11y-close" id="a11yClose">Close</button>

<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.documentElement;

  /* restore whatever was chosen last time, before anything paints */
  try{
    var v = localStorage.getItem('baci-view');
    var t = localStorage.getItem('baci-text');
    if(v === 'light'){
      root.setAttribute('data-view','light');
      var tc0 = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
      if(tc0) tc0.setAttribute('content', '#F7F4EE');
    }
    if(t) root.style.setProperty('--text-scale', t);
  }catch(e){}

  var toggle = document.getElementById('a11y');
  var panel  = document.getElementById('a11yPanel');
  if(!toggle || !panel) return;

  var viewBtn = document.getElementById('a11yView');
  var smaller = document.getElementById('a11ySmaller');
  var larger  = document.getElementById('a11yLarger');
  var closeB  = document.getElementById('a11yClose');

  var STEPS = [1, 1.12, 1.25, 1.4];

  function currentStep(){
    var s = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--text-scale')) || 1;
    var i = 0, best = 9;
    STEPS.forEach(function(v, n){
      var d = Math.abs(v - s);
      if(d < best){ best = d; i = n; }
    });
    return i;
  }

  function setScale(i){
    i = Math.max(0, Math.min(STEPS.length - 1, i));
    root.style.setProperty('--text-scale', STEPS[i]);
    try{ localStorage.setItem('baci-text', STEPS[i]); }catch(e){}
  }

  function syncView(){
    var light = root.getAttribute('data-view') === 'light';
    viewBtn.textContent = light ? 'Light' : 'Dark';
    viewBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(light));
    /* the iOS status bar and Safari's chrome read this, and it is markup
       rather than CSS, so the toggle has to move it by hand */
    var tc = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if(tc) tc.setAttribute('content', light ? '#F7F4EE' : '#000000');
  }

  function open(){
    panel.classList.add('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    syncView();
    viewBtn.focus();
  }
  function close(){
    panel.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  }

  toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    panel.classList.contains('open') ? close() : open();
  });

  viewBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var light = root.getAttribute('data-view') === 'light';
    if(light){ root.removeAttribute('data-view'); }
    else { root.setAttribute('data-view','light'); }
    try{ localStorage.setItem('baci-view', light ? 'dark' : 'light'); }catch(e){}
    syncView();
  });

  smaller.addEventListener('click', function(){ setScale(currentStep() - 1); });
  larger .addEventListener('click', function(){ setScale(currentStep() + 1); });
  closeB .addEventListener('click', close);

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key === 'Escape' && panel.classList.contains('open')) { close(); toggle.focus(); }
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!panel.contains(e.target) && !toggle.contains(e.target)) close();
  });

  syncView();
})();
</script>


<!-- ══ §7 SEARCH OTHER INDUSTRIES — the control on the artwork, made real ══ -->
<script>
(function(){
  var link  = document.getElementById('expSearch');
  var panel = document.getElementById('indSearch');
  var input = document.getElementById('indSearchInput');
  var out   = document.getElementById('indSearchOut');
  if(!link || !panel || !input || !out) return;

  /* Fifteen industries are already painted on the tile, so searching only
     those would be theatre. What is not visible is the 180 sub-sectors
     underneath them, which is what someone typing "pharma" or "hotels" is
     actually looking for. Both are searched; a sub-sector carries its
     industry with it. */
  var TAX = window.BACI_TAXONOMY;
  if(!TAX || !TAX.industries) { link.style.display='none'; return; }
  var INDEX = [];
  TAX.industries.forEach(function(ind){
    INDEX.push({ label: ind, industry: ind, sub: null, kind: 'Industry' });
    (TAX.subsectors[ind] || []).forEach(function(sub){
      INDEX.push({ label: sub, industry: ind, sub: sub, kind: ind });
    });
  });

  function esc(t){ return String(t).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){
    return ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'})[c]; }); }

  function search(q){
    q = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    if(q.length < 2) return [];
    var starts = [], contains = [];
    for(var i=0; i<INDEX.length; i++){
      var l = INDEX[i].label.toLowerCase();
      if(l.indexOf(q) === 0) starts.push(INDEX[i]);
      else if(l.indexOf(q) > -1) contains.push(INDEX[i]);
    }
    return starts.concat(contains).slice(0, 8);
  }

  function render(){
    var q = input.value, hits = search(q);
    if(q.trim().length < 2){ out.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    if(!hits.length){
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="ind-search__none">No match in the fifteen industries or their ' +
        'sub-sectors. BACI can still be pointed at yours — tell us what it is.</p>' +
        '<div class="cta-wrap"><a class="cta" href="#access"><span class="cta__text">CONNECT YOUR BUSINESS</span>' +
        '<span class="cta__conduit"><span class="cta__dot"></span></span></a></div>';
      if(typeof measureCTAs === 'function') measureCTAs();
      return;
    }
    out.innerHTML = hits.map(function(h,i){
      return '<button type="button" class="ind-hit" data-i="'+i+'">' +
             (h.sub ? '<span>'+esc(h.kind)+'</span>' : '<span>Industry</span>') +
             esc(h.label) + '</button>';
    }).join('');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(out.querySelectorAll('.ind-hit'), function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var h = hits[+btn.getAttribute('data-i')];
        close();
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('baci:industry',
          { detail: { industry: h.industry, sub: h.sub } }));
      });
    });
  }

  function open(){
    /* the pin panel uses the same space; only one at a time */
    var pin = document.getElementById('pinPanel');
    if(pin && pin.classList.contains('is-open')) pin.classList.remove('is-open');
    panel.classList.add('is-open');
    link.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    setTimeout(function(){ input.focus(); }, 120);
  }
  function close(){
    panel.classList.remove('is-open');
    link.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    input.value = '';
    setTimeout(function(){ if(!panel.classList.contains('is-open')) out.innerHTML = ''; }, 460);
  }

  link.setAttribute('role','button');
  link.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  link.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(panel.classList.contains('is-open')) close(); else open();
  });
  input.addEventListener('input', render);
  input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key === 'Escape'){ close(); link.focus(); }
    if(e.key === 'Enter'){
      var first = out.querySelector('.ind-hit');
      if(first){ e.preventDefault(); first.click(); }
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!panel.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    if(panel.contains(e.target) || link.contains(e.target)) return;
    close();
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- ══ §7 MESH PINS — the five signal types, counted from what scrapex holds ══ -->
<script>
(function(){
  var layer = document.getElementById('meshPins');
  var panel = document.getElementById('pinPanel');
  if(!layer || !panel) return;

  /* label boxes measured off the 1536x1024 artwork, so each target sits on its
     own painted words rather than on a guess */
  var TW = 1536, TH = 1024;
  var PINS = [
    { k:'audience_shifts', name:'Audience Shifts', box:[608,221,753,235], cap:'Audience signals collected',
      line:'What people are saying and where their attention is moving, read from reviews, forums, communities and social platforms — so a market changing its mind shows up before the numbers do.' },
    { k:'opportunities', name:'Opportunities', box:[826,179,955,193], cap:'Opportunities identified',
      line:'Partnerships, affiliate openings and routes to market, surfaced as they appear rather than after the advantage has already gone.' },
    { k:'content_velocity', name:'Content Velocity', box:[954,100,1123,114], cap:'In the last 24 hours',
      line:'How fast a subject is being published, posted and talked about right now. The rate, not the volume, because acceleration is what tells you something is starting.' },
    { k:'market_movement', name:'Market Movement', box:[1285,69,1443,83], cap:'Market signals collected',
      line:'Pricing changes, product launches, regulatory shifts and market signals, gathered as they land across the markets that matter to your business.' },
    { k:'demand_signals', name:'Demand Signals', box:[1125,326,1318,340], cap:'Demand signals collected',
      line:'Where demand is forming, rising or falling, read from search behaviour, trend data and the language people use when they are close to buying.' }
  ];

  function esc(t){ return String(t).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){
    return ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'})[c]; }); }

  layer.innerHTML = PINS.map(function(p,i){
    var b=p.box;
    var st='left:'+(b[0]/TW*100).toFixed(3)+'%;top:'+(b[1]/TH*100).toFixed(3)+'%;'+
           'width:'+((b[2]-b[0])/TW*100).toFixed(3)+'%;height:'+((b[3]-b[1])/TH*100).toFixed(3)+'%';
    return '<button type="button" class="pin" style="'+st+'" data-i="'+i+'" aria-expanded="false">'+
           '<span class="visually-hidden">'+esc(p.name)+'</span></button>';
  }).join('');
  var btns = layer.querySelectorAll('.pin');

  /* ── counts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     scrapex is the unrestricted global supply chain, so nothing here is
     narrowed by industry, tenant or country. A pin filters to its own
     signal type and to nothing else. Where the collection is not yet
     meaningful the line stands on its own, without a number. */
  var API = 'https://api.bacihq.com/api/signals/pins';
  var cache = null, cacheAt = 0, inflight = null, TTL = 60000;

  function counts(){
    var now = Date.now();
    if(cache && now - cacheAt < TTL) return Promise.resolve(cache);
    if(inflight) return inflight;
    inflight = fetch(API, {credentials:'omit'})
      .then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
      .then(function(j){ cache = j || {}; cacheAt = Date.now(); inflight = null; return cache; })
      .catch(function(){ cache = {}; cacheAt = Date.now(); inflight = null; return cache; });
    return inflight;
  }

  var raf = 0;
  function stopCount(){ if(raf){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; } }

  function countTo(el, target){
    stopCount();
    var t0 = 0, dur = 1100;
    (function step(ts){
      if(!t0) t0 = ts;
      var q = Math.min(1, (ts - t0) / dur);
      var e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - q, 3);
      el.textContent = Math.round(target * e).toLocaleString('en-GB');
      if(q < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); else raf = 0;
    })(0 || performance.now());
  }

  var open = -1;

  function close(){
    stopCount();
    open = -1;
    panel.classList.remove('is-open');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(btns, function(b){
      b.classList.remove('is-open'); b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    });
    /* nothing left running or rendered once it is shut */
    setTimeout(function(){ if(open === -1) panel.innerHTML = ''; }, 520);
  }

  function show(i){
    var p = PINS[i];
    open = i;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(btns, function(b,j){
      b.classList.toggle('is-open', j === i);
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', j === i ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    panel.innerHTML =
      '<p class="pin-panel__name">' + esc(p.name) + '</p>' +
      '<div class="pin-panel__rule"></div>' +
      '<p class="pin-panel__line">' + esc(p.line) + '</p>' +
      '<p class="pin-panel__num" id="pinNum" style="display:none"></p>' +
      '<p class="pin-panel__cap" id="pinCap" style="display:none">' + esc(p.cap) + '</p>';
    panel.classList.add('is-open');

    counts().then(function(data){
      if(open !== i) return;                     /* closed or swapped while fetching */
      var d = data && data[p.k];
      var v = (d && d.sufficient && typeof d.count === 'number') ? d.count : null;
      var num = document.getElementById('pinNum'), cap = document.getElementById('pinCap');
      if(v === null || !num) return;             /* no number yet: the line stands alone */
      num.style.display = ''; if(cap) cap.style.display = '';
      countTo(num, v);
    });
  }

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(btns, function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      var i = +b.getAttribute('data-i');
      if(i === open) close(); else show(i);
    });
  });

  /* tapping an industry, or anywhere off the pins, puts the panel away */
  var tabs = document.getElementById('indTabs');
  if(tabs) tabs.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(open !== -1) close(); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(open === -1) return;
    if(layer.contains(e.target) || panel.contains(e.target)) return;
    close();
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- ══ §7 INTELLIGENCE ZONE — particle disperse / reform ══ -->
<script>
(function(){
  var wrap = document.querySelector('.explorer__zone');
  var cvs  = document.getElementById('izoneCanvas');
  if(!wrap || !cvs || !cvs.getContext) { if(wrap) wrap.style.display='none'; return; }

  var RM = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
  var W = 1146, H = 656;                  /* the box her artwork leaves for the ring */
  cvs.width = W; cvs.height = H;
  var ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');

  var img = new Image();
  img.decoding = 'async';
  img.onerror = function(){ wrap.style.display = 'none'; };
  img.onload  = function(){ build(); };
  img.src = 'data:image/webp;base64,';

  var P = null, cx = W/2, cy = H/2, radius = H*0.46;

  function build(){
    /* draw the source once, sample it, then work only from particles */
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, W, H);

    if(RM){ return; }                       /* static: leave the drawn image in place */

    var src;
    try { src = ctx.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data; }
    catch(e){ return; }                     /* readback blocked: keep the static image */

    var cand = [], step = 2, i, x, y, a, lum;
    for(y=0; y<H; y+=step){
      for(x=0; x<W; x+=step){
        i = (y*W + x) * 4;
        a = src[i+3]; if(a < 20) continue;
        lum = (src[i]*0.2126 + src[i+1]*0.7152 + src[i+2]*0.0722) * (a/255);
        if(lum < 26) continue;
        cand.push([x, y, src[i], src[i+1], src[i+2], a]);
      }
    }
    if(!cand.length){ return; }

    var MAX = 16000, keep = cand;
    if(cand.length > MAX){
      keep = []; var stride = cand.length / MAX;
      for(i=0; i<MAX; i++) keep.push(cand[(i*stride)|0]);
    }

    P = new Array(keep.length);
    for(i=0; i<keep.length; i++){
      var c = keep[i];
      var dx = c[0]-cx, dy = c[1]-cy;
      var d  = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) || 1;
      var jit = (Math.random()-0.5)*0.55;
      var ux = dx/d, uy = dy/d;
      var nx = ux*Math.cos(jit) - uy*Math.sin(jit);
      var ny = ux*Math.sin(jit) + uy*Math.cos(jit);
      P[i] = {
        x:c[0], y:c[1], r:c[2], g:c[3], b:c[4], a:c[5],
        vx:nx, vy:ny,
        /* outer particles travel further, so the ring opens rather than inflates */
        reach: (0.55 + 0.85*Math.min(d/radius,1.4)) * (0.7 + Math.random()*0.6),
        lag: Math.random()*0.16
      };
    }

    buf = ctx.createImageData(W,H);
    running = true;
    io.observe(wrap);
  }

  /* ── cycle: quick apart, slow together, then a beat held whole ── */
  var OUT = 1800, LOOSE = 600, BACK = 4000, HOLD = 900;
  var PERIOD = OUT + LOOSE + BACK + HOLD;
  var BASE = 0.20;                 /* resting amplitude, as a share of radius */
  var buf = null, running = false, visible = false, raf = 0;
  var t0 = 0, burst = 0;

  function easeOut(p){ return 1 - (1-p)*(1-p); }
  function easeInOut(p){ return p<0.5 ? 2*p*p : 1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2; }

  function phase(ms){
    var t = ms % PERIOD;
    if(t < OUT)               return easeOut(t/OUT);
    if(t < OUT+LOOSE)         return 1;
    if(t < OUT+LOOSE+BACK)    return 1 - easeInOut((t-OUT-LOOSE)/BACK);
    return 0;
  }

  function frame(ts){
    if(!running || !visible){ raf = 0; return; }
    if(!t0) t0 = ts;
    var ms = ts - t0;

    if(burst > 0){ burst = Math.max(0, burst - 0.00016*16.7); }
    var amp = (BASE + burst) * radius;
    var k = phase(ms);

    var d = buf.data;
    d.fill(0);

    for(var i=0; i<P.length; i++){
      var p = P[i];
      var kp = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (k - p.lag) / (1 - p.lag)));
      var off = kp * amp * p.reach;
      var x = (p.x + p.vx*off)|0;
      var y = (p.y + p.vy*off)|0;
      if(x<0 || y<0 || x>=W || y>=H) continue;
      /* never fully gone: alpha floors at 45% at the loosest point */
      var al = p.a * (1 - 0.55*kp);
      /* a single pixel per particle left the reformed ring thinner than the
         artwork it was sampled from, so each one is stamped 2x2 */
      var j = (y*W + x)*4;
      if(al > d[j+3]){ d[j]=p.r; d[j+1]=p.g; d[j+2]=p.b; d[j+3]=al; }
      if(x+1<W){ j+=4; if(al > d[j+3]){ d[j]=p.r; d[j+1]=p.g; d[j+2]=p.b; d[j+3]=al; } }
      if(y+1<H){
        j = ((y+1)*W + x)*4;
        if(al > d[j+3]){ d[j]=p.r; d[j+1]=p.g; d[j+2]=p.b; d[j+3]=al; }
        if(x+1<W){ j+=4; if(al > d[j+3]){ d[j]=p.r; d[j+1]=p.g; d[j+2]=p.b; d[j+3]=al; } }
      }
    }
    ctx.putImageData(buf,0,0);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
    visible = es[0].isIntersecting;
    if(visible && running && !raf){ t0 = 0; raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  }, {threshold:0.05});

  /* industry switch: one deeper cycle, then settle back to the resting rhythm */
  var tabs = document.getElementById('indTabs');
  if(tabs){
    tabs.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if(!running) return;
      burst = 0.34;
      t0 = 0;
    }, true);
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var cards=document.querySelectorAll('#business-os .bcard');
  function toggle(card){
    var open=card.classList.contains('is-open');
    cards.forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('is-open');c.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');});
    if(!open){card.classList.add('is-open');card.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');}
  }
  cards.forEach(function(card){
    card.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target.closest('a'))return;toggle(card);});
    card.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggle(card);}});
  });
})();
</script>
